title: Flip Equivalent Binary Trees
description:
A flip operation swaps the left and right subtrees of any node. Given two binary trees, return `True` if one can be made identical to the other using flip operations, and `False` otherwise.

## Examples

```text
Input: root1 = [1,2,3,4,5,6,null,null,null,7,8], root2 = [1,3,2,null,6,4,5,null,null,null,null,8,7]
Output: true
```

```text
Input: root1 = [], root2 = [1]
Output: false
```

## Constraints

- Each tree has `[0, 100]` nodes
- Values are unique within each tree and in `[0, 99]`
